mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE b.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, loan_id, l.book_id, title, author, publisher, cheonggu, l.userid, loan_date, return_date, due_date, loan_state, CASE WHEN ((return_date - loan_date) > due_date) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS overdue_state FROM lib_loans l INNER JOIN lib_member m ON m.userid = l.userid INNER JOIN lib_books b ON b.book_id = l.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) or l.userid like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') order by loan_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}

select count(*) from lib_loans l INNER JOIN lib_member m ON m.userid = l.userid INNER JOIN lib_books b ON b.book_id = l.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) or l.userid like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')
mapper.update: update lib_loans set userid = #{userid}, loan_date = #{loanDate}, due_date = (#{returnDate}::DATE - #{loanDate}::DATE), return_date = #{returnDate}, loan_state = #{loanState} where loan_id = #{loanId}
update lib_loans set loan_state = 'N', due_date = 0, return_date = loan_date where loan_id = #{loanId}
